validation_plan.H: On lawful held-out BBBC006 fluorescence planes, selected w1 Cell/w2 Face improve PSNR without degrading morphology compared to matched ordinary deblur baseline; do not assert recovered detail is ground truth.
validation_plan.T: At least 100 fields per channel grouped by well and unseen focal planes; paired bootstrap 95% CI, original in-focus z16 and fixed acquisition parameters, compare PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS and segmentation/count/intensity fidelity. Freeze GPU SKU/driver/CUDA ABI, image shape, batch1, FP32 and 30 latency/memory runs. No execution this round.
validation_plan.D: Proposed PASS if PSNR paired 95% lower bound >0 dB, nuclear count absolute relative error median no worse than matched baseline, no nonfinite outputs; FAIL if upper bound <=0 or verified morphology/measurement deterioration; otherwise UNCERTAIN. Separate rights/storage approval.
validation_plan.C: Plate leakage, focus-plane distribution shift, artificially sharpened features, mismatched preprocessing, raw vs EMA or backend variation.
validation_plan.U: Sampling/measurement and calibration errors not measured; combined uncertainty unknown; no hardware performance extrapolation.
